newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian stocks mixed, most blue chips down.
newsitem.headline: Croatian stocks mixed, most blue chips down.

text.p: Croatian stocks were mixed on Thursday, with mild losses in fully listed issues and most hoteliers.
* Of eight active issues, three rose, four fell and one was flat.
* Volume shrank to 4,861 units, turnover also lower at 4.8 million.
* Biggest gainer hotelier Laguna climbed 40 kuna to 1,050 with 93 shares sold.
* Top loser hotelier Istraturist dropped 40 kuna to 140, selling 170 shares.
* Most active food processor Podravka inched up eight kuna to 228 on volume of 1,510 shares.
